question.text: A stock broker facing a technical glitch that disrupts trading services must inform the stock exchange within what maximum time, and submit a Preliminary Incident Report (PIR) by when?

answer.text: Inform the exchange within 1 hour of the glitch; submit PIR within T+1 day
Inform the exchange within 24 hours; submit PIR within T+7 days
Inform the exchange within 30 minutes; submit PIR within same trading day
Inform the exchange within 4 hours; submit PIR within T+3 days

explanation.text: The Logic: The source states that stock brokers shall inform the stock exchanges of a technical glitch immediately but not later than 1 hour from the time of occurrence, and shall submit a Preliminary Incident Report (PIR) to the exchange within T+1 day of the incident. The Trap: Both deadlines must be combined: "immediately, within 1 hour" for notification AND "T+1 day" for the PIR. Note: After the PIR, the broker must submit a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Report within 14 days from the date of the incident. Sequence: 1 hour notification, then T+1 PIR, then 14-day RCA.
